Competent officer of an under-resourced royal expedition; neither a villain nor a richly decorated noble. No crown, no medals, no sword, no glowing runes. Distinct silhouette with short squared pauldrons and upright bearing.

Use case: stylized-concept. Wide 16:9 story backdrop for Depths, a grim first-person medieval dungeon crawler. Seen from just inside a natural cave mouth looking outward to an overcast muddy relief camp approach. Jagged grey cave lips frame the left and right, the middle opens to cool daylight, tired scrub trees and a distant canvas supply wagon. THREE ordinary royal soldiers waiting by the cave path in worn plain iron helmets and dark muted red wool, spears grounded, one talking to another, small figures in middle distance off-centre. No prominent commander, no close faces, no rich parade army, no heraldic logos, no text. Dirty boot tracks and a few supply crates settle the people into the environment. Broad readable hand-painted pixel clusters, restrained earthy grey/umber/slate green palette, chunky silhouettes, not high-detail oil painting, not smooth 3D, no sun flare, no magic glow. Intentionally quiet central foreground so a conversation panel can cover it. Landscape backdrop, no frame or UI, opaque image.

Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit this existing cave-in game prop into its DEALT-WITH visual state, preserving the exact square canvas, transparent background, camera, scale, placement, diagonal cracked beam, wooden frame, rocks, cup and all outer contours. Only a small local change: shift two or three small stones at the lower breathing gap, scatter some fresh pale stone dust there, and add three rough short vertical chalk strokes on the large flat lower-left stone to indicate the site has been attended to. The rubble fall and cracked beam remain largely in place. The cup remains. Do NOT create a walk-through opening, add a person, remove the beam or broadly redraw the rock face. This shared state is used for both rescue and a marked crew site, so avoid implying a fully opened passage. Keep the same coarse muted painted pixel art, no new lighting, no text or labels.
